caption:
बॉस! रणबीर कपूर की फिल्म ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है! 💥
दूसरे शनिवार यानी आठवें दिन भी फिल्म ने पचास करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है। 🎬
अर्ली ट्रेंड्स के मुताबिक सभी भाषाओं को मिलाकर दूसरे गुरुवार को फिल्म ने चौवन करोड़ नेट कमाए। 💰
इसके साथ ही फिल्म ने बॉलीवुड का सबसे बड़ा दूसरा गुरुवार दर्ज कर लिया है और धुरंधर 2 को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 📈
आठ दिनों का कुल नेट कलेक्शन पांच सौ इक्यासी दशमलव नौ एक करोड़ पहुंच चुका है। 🌟
इस कमाई के साथ रामायण, एनिमल के पांच सौ चौवन करोड़ के आंकड़े को पीछे छोड़कर रणबीर की सबसे ज्यादा कमाने वाली फिल्म बन गई है। 🏆
क्या यह फिल्म भारत में एक हजार करोड़ का नेट ग्रॉसर पार कर पाएगी? 🤔

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Day 8 (Early Trends): Becomes Ranbir Kapoor’s Highest-Grosser In India, Scores Bollywood’s Biggest 2nd Thursday
ctx.summary:
Ramayana had another strong day at the Indian box office, scoring above 50 crore net on its second Thursday, day 8. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 8 (Early Trends): Becomes Ranbir Kapoor’s Highest-Grosser In India, Scores Bollywood’s Biggest 2nd Thursday  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, has wrapped up its 8-day extended opening week on a high note. Even on the second Saturday, day 8, the magnum opus didn’t fall below the 50 crore mark, an encouraging sign heading into the second weekend. In the meantime, it has registered Bollywood’s biggest second Thursday at the Indian box office and gone past the 550 crore mark in net collections. Keep reading to know what early trends suggest!
Although the Diwali festivities ended yesterday, some states still had extended vacations, which definitely helped the film. In the Hindi version alone, it scored an estimated 43.5 crore net on its second Thursday. Combining all the dubbed versions, it earned 54 crore net, as per early trends flowing in. With this, the film has registered Bollywood’s biggest second Thursday in India, surpassing Dhurandhar 2 ( 53 crore ).
Overall, Ramayana has wrapped up its 8-day extended opening week at a whopping 581.91 crore* net (all languages) at the Indian box office. It equals 686.65 crore gross. With such strong momentum over the first week, the film is all set for a complete blast in the second weekend.
With 581.91 crore*, Ramayana has become Ranbir Kapoor’s highest-grossing film of all time in India. It dethroned Animal ( 554 crore ) to secure the top spot. Given the momentum of the film, it is now safe to say that Ranbir is all set to deliver his first 1000 crore net grosser.
